newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Deng's health "all right" for his age - official.
newsitem.headline: Deng's health "all right" for his age - official.

text.p: A senior Chinese official described paramount leader Deng Xiaoping's health as all right for a man of his age, Hong Kong television station TVB reported on Saturday from Singapore.

"I think, for someone of that advanced age, the state of his health should be described as all right," Guo Chongli, a spokesman for China's delegation to a meeting of European and Asian foreign ministers was broadcast as saying.
Guo said the state of Deng's health was evident from the fact that Chinese Vice Premier and Foreign Minister Qian Qichen attended the high-profile meeting in Singapore.
"Otherwise, Minister Qian wouldn't be here for the meeting," Guo said.
Rumours about Deng's health surface periodically.
Deng, 92, has not been seen in public since the 1994 Chinese lunar new year festival when he visited Shanghai and appeared frail and faltering.
